# The busiest street that is not a motorway, closed for the morning: every link of its OpenStreetMap way.
road = before.link_bins_table().to_pandas()
classes = dict(zip(network.link_ids(), (ms.LINK_CLASSES[c] for c in network.link_class())))
streets = road[road["link"].map(classes).isin(["primary", "secondary", "tertiary"])]
busiest = streets.groupby("link")["pcu"].sum().idxmax()
works = [link for link in network.link_ids() if link.split(":")[0] == busiest.split(":")[0]]
closed = base.replace(network=ms.network_edit(network, close=works)).run("delft-closed")
